name: Faith And Words
overview: Scripture reveals the profound connection between faith and the words we speak. Proverbs teaches that the tongue holds the power of life and death, capable of healing or harm, while Jesus emphasizes that even small faith can command great outcomes, such as moving mountains by speaking in faith. Furthermore, every idle word will be accounted for, underscoring the responsibility believers have to align their speech with their faith. Ultimately, faith itself arises through hearing the word of God, linking the spoken message of Scripture directly to the believer’s trust and confession.
